sheets.title: SECOND FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Second floor plan for a 3-story apartment building at 1301 Sanderson Road. Architectural Concepts logo in title block. Scale 3/16" = 1'-0". Shows multiple apartment unit layouts. Proposed sprinkler room indicated. This sheet number (A0.0) reused for second floor plan — unusual. Title block shows address as 1301 Sanderson Road, not the Virginia Beach address shown in MEP drawings. Drawing set is prelim/preliminary.

sheets.title: FIRST FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: First floor plan, same building. Scale 3/16" = 1'-0". Shows proposed sprinkler rooms at both ends of the building. Unit numbering visible. Multiple unit types visible.

sheets.title: THIRD FLOOR PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Third floor plan. Scale 3/16" = 1'-0". Building overall width approximately 151'-3". Confirms 3-story building. Unit layouts similar to floors 1 and 2.

sheets.title: FRONT AND REAR ELEVATION PROPOSED
sheets.reading_notes: Front and rear elevations. Building shows 3 stories, pitched/hip roof system with composition shingles implied. Scale 3/16" = 1'-0". Typical residential apartment building form.

sheets.title: RIGHT AND LEFT ELEVATION PROPOSED

sheets.title: ROOF PLAN

sheets.title: LEGEND, EQUIPMENT LIST, SCHEDULES AND GENERAL NOTES
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: BFA-authored sheet. Project: 3148 Hunters Chase, Virginia Beach, VA. Job# DM5-21. Date: 11/26/2021. Pre-final submittal, second round of responses. Contains plumbing fixture connection schedule (P-1 flush tank water closet, P-2 counter mounted lavatory, P-3 counter kitchen sink, P-4 shower/tub combination, P-5 washer connection box). Equipment list specifies 47-gallon electric water heaters for 1BR units (EWH-1, 4500W, 240V, 20 GPH recovery) and 66-gallon electric water heaters for 2BR units (EWH-2, 1500W, 240V, 32 GPH recovery). Garbage disposal: 1/3 HP, 120V. Expansion tank specified. General notes reference compliance with state building codes, ASHRAE, IPC, IPC, and applicable regulatory standards.

sheets.title: OVERALL PLAN — NEW WORK
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: Overall floor plan for new plumbing work. Multi-unit apartment building shown. Building has at least 2 end units (2BR with BEDROOM #1 and BEDROOM #2) and multiple center units (1BR with single BEDROOM #1). End units have two bathrooms (BTH 1 and BTH 2); center units have one bath. Kitchens with W.DECK (likely wood deck or wet deck). All new work. Two construction notes: (1) typical 2BR unit layout, see P1.1; (2) typical 1BR unit layout, see P1.1.

sheets.title: PLUMBING PLANS — NEW WORK (TYPICAL UNIT PLANS)
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: Typical plumbing plans at 1/4" = 1'-0" scale. Left side: 2BR unit plan showing domestic cold water (3/4" CW) and hot water (HW) distribution, EWH-1 electric water heater under AHU, sanitary/DWV, washer box (P-5), all fixture connections. Right side: 1BR unit plan showing similar system, EWH-2. Water heater mounted under air handling unit — confirms HVAC split system/AHU present. Drain for AHU condensate shown routed to sanitary. Piping size: 3/4" CW and HW throughout unit, 1/2" CW branch to kitchen. Existing piping noted as remaining; contractor to provide all fittings for connection to new piping.

sheets.title: DETAILS
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: Three details: (1) Washing Machine Utility Box Detail — recess box with 3/4" HW and CW lines and 2" standpipe for wash machine drain; (2) Water Heater Piping Diagram — dielectric union, T&P relief valve, expansion tank connection, heat traps; (3) Vent Through Roof Detail — VTR pipe flashing with S.S. draw band, sealant, lap shingles over flange, wood roof truss.

sheets.title: DETAILS (FIRE-RESISTIVE ASSEMBLIES)
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: UL-listed fire-resistive assembly details for floor-ceiling and wall penetrations. Systems shown: F-C-1010 (floor-ceiling, 1-2 hr), F-C-1074 (floor-ceiling), F-C-2032 (floor-ceiling). Details show penetration sealing requirements for metallic pipe/conduit through fire-rated assemblies. References UL L500 series, L300 series floor-ceiling designs. Specified Technologies Inc. products referenced. Through-penetrant materials listed including steel pipe, copper pipe, conduit. T-ratings and F-ratings tabulated.

sheets.title: DETAILS (FIRE-RESISTIVE ASSEMBLIES — WALLS)
sheets.source_pdf: PLUMBING AND MECHANICAL DWGS 12-20-21_second round of responses.pdf
sheets.reading_notes: UL-listed wall penetration details: F-C-2157, W-L-1040, W-L-2241. Wall assembly penetration sealing for 1-2 hr rated walls. Pipe types: PVC, CPVC, ABS, PEX, flexible metal conduit. Through-penetrant sealing materials including STI SpecSeal products, caulk, and collars. Omega Flex gastite, Ward Mfg. referenced for gas tubing. References NFPA 70 (National Electrical Code) for electrical tubing installations.
